title: Hope Fridge mission and systems statement

title: Area-code-hunt shard B: 274, 283, 301
summary: Bounded dedicated area-code-hunt shard-B pass over the next three unresolved authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs after 262. Seven distinct organization identities were materialized with separate investigation targets, current-status controls, public communication endpoints where resolved, one cautious outward organization relation, and area-code/locality relations. No current organization was labeled anarchist without explicit evidence and no individual political affiliation or violent-conduct claim was inferred.

data.research_question: Which public organizations matching or closely adjacent to the requested anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid and organization-network seed families can be defensibly enumerated from shard-B area codes 274, 283 and 301?
data.method: Dedicated area-code-hunt-v1-expanded pass; current authoritative NANPA U.S. geographic-NPA gate; deterministic npa mod 3 sharding; literal code searches for anarchists, anarchist collective, anarchist black cross, Food Not Bombs and mutual aid plus Green Bay/Appleton/Oshkosh/Fox Valley, Cincinnati, and Frederick/Hagerstown/Silver Spring/Takoma Park locality searches; first-party organization sites, movement directories, public Linktree/social surfaces, current event/news pages, Reddit discovery, and repository dedupe. Historical directories were used only as discovery/identity-continuity seeds and were not treated as proof of current status. X and Reddit official APIs were not used.
classification_rules: Only current authoritative U.S. geographic NPAs are eligible seeds; invalid, foreign, service, reserved and planned-not-yet-in-service codes are excluded before sharding.
Organizations retain their own public self-description; mutual-aid, Food Not Bombs, cooperative, civic, rapid-response or adjacent groups are not silently relabeled anarchist.
Historical directory/account continuity is not assumed without current corroboration.
Individual political affiliation and violent conduct are never inferred from organization proximity or participation.
Name or handle similarity alone never merges organizations.
